armor-penalty-reduction.Name: Fix: upgrades that reduce armor penalty
armor-penalty-reduction.Hint: Makes Ajustada (Adjusted), Sob Medida (Under Measure) and Mitral (Mithril) reduce the item's armor penalty (down to 0) instead of increasing it. Affects skills and rolls; the item sheet keeps showing the base penalty.

Notifications.error: Tormenta20 Community Patches: failed to apply "{name}" ({reason}). Check the console (F12).
Notifications.fixed: Tormenta20 Community Patches: "{name}" is no longer needed, because {reason} already fixes the bug. The patch was switched off automatically.
Notifications.unverified: Tormenta20 Community Patches: "{name}" was not applied because version {reason} has not been verified yet and the bug could not be confirmed.
Notifications.applied-unverified: Tormenta20 Community Patches: "{name}" is still applied on {reason} (unverified version), because the bug was still detected.
Notifications.incompatible: Tormenta20 Community Patches: "{name}" does not apply to {reason}.

Manager.Name: Patches
Manager.Label: Manage patches
Manager.Hint: Turns each patch on or off and shows whether it is applied on this Tormenta20 version.
Manager.Title: Tormenta20 Community Patches
Manager.Intro: Each patch is only applied while the bug exists in the system. When a new Tormenta20 release fixes the bug, the patch is switched off automatically and shows as "Fixed in the system". Changes require reloading the world.
Manager.PendingReload: Some saved changes only take effect after reloading the world (F5).

applied.Label: Applied
applied.Hint: The bug exists in this system version and the patch is active.

applied-unverified.Label: Applied (unverified version)
applied-unverified.Hint: Version {reason} has not been verified yet, but the module's check detected the bug, so the patch is active.

disabled.Label: Off
disabled.Hint: Patch turned off in this window.

fixed.Label: Fixed in the system
fixed.Hint: The module's check indicates that {reason} already fixes this bug. The patch is not applied.

unverified.Label: Unverified version
unverified.Hint: The bug could not be confirmed on {reason}. The patch is not applied until a new module release.

incompatible.Label: Incompatible
incompatible.Hint: This patch does not apply to {reason}.

error.Label: Error
error.Hint: Failed to apply: {reason}. Check the console (F12).
